integrity: Originality is limited to the stated equivariant representation and quotient consequence. Infinite-family proof is structural; finite checks are reproducibility tests, not a substitute. No independent scientific validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The nonequivariant homotopy classification is already a specialization of Deshpande and Singh, Theorem 3.10 (2021), and is explicitly excluded from the originality claim. New assertions concern the exact integral automorphism representation and the derived rational full-automorphism orbit homology. No integral quotient-homology or equivariant homotopy-type claim is made. Search cannot exclude unindexed earlier equivariant treatments.
title: Integral symmetry modules and orbit homology of double-star higher-independence complexes
